name: Observateur des Confins
description: Stratège neutre coordonnant les mouvements de plusieurs factions alliées lors des opérations multi-équipes.

subject.archetype: Observateur des Confins — neutre Rare class None

loadout.armor_outfit: Layered patched armor made from mismatched faction materials welded and stitched together, bullet-pocked shoulder plates, faded utility harness loaded with ammunition and tools with distinctive faction engravings and glowing energy channel conduits running along seams
loadout.arsenal: Worn plasma rifle with taped grip sections and custom sight modifications, combat knife with notched blade, compact EMP grenades on belt Functional combat equipment showing signs of heavy practical use and field customization

attitude.behavior: Tactical coordinator positioned between allied units with hands raised directing coordinated movements. Combat stance with weapon or tool raised and ready, eyes locked on approaching threat, body coiled like a spring ready to explode into action
attitude.emotion: Lethal intensity — predator recognizing the perfect strike moment

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Dusty Steel Gray
palette_names.role: primary_accent — weathered armor and tactical gear

palette_names.name: Warm Amber
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — muzzle flash and eye reflection

color_and_light.lighting_setup: cobalt steel frame with etched faction symbols running along each border edge, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Low dramatic angle emphasizing dominance, wide enough to show full environmental impact of the ability

scenography.setting: Active warzone at an asteroid waystation crossroads under attack, plasma rounds impacting nearby corrugated walls sending debris and sparks raining down, allied forces taking cover behind makeshift barricades while enemy silhouettes advance through thick smoke
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Tension and lethal potential visible in every tensed muscle — combat readiness radiating from posture and grip on weapon, Active combat zone with explosions and engagements around the character, allies and enemies locked in fierce battle, chaos of war as backdrop, Fine stellar dust swirling in air, muzzle flashes cutting through haze, shell casings ejecting in slow motion, debris kicked up by heavy boots, sparks ricocheting off metal surfaces
